name: Bhop Records
description: Leaderboards for the OpenCitadel bhop mode: keeps every map's best times, announces records in game and on Discord, and shows the current map's record in the server listing. Pairs with the bhop Deadworks plugin and map-rotation.
author: OpenCitadel

announce.description: What to announce in chat: records (map records only), pbs (map records and personal bests) or none.

webhookUrl.description: Discord webhook URL for map records. Empty turns Discord posts off.

leaderboardSize.description: How many times to keep per map and style.
